reviews.text:
We contacted Marie-Mey for our little dachshund, Blue, and we are delighted with the support she provided.

We chose Marie-Mey for her compassionate approach, which truly helped us understand why our dog exhibited certain behaviors rather than simply trying to correct them.

Marie-Mey's advice and helpful tips are very practical and, above all, easy to implement on a daily basis. She also takes the time to explain things in simple terms, which allows us to better understand and apply her advice with confidence.

Since starting our sessions, we have gained a much better understanding of Blue, her needs, and her reactions… but also a better understanding of ourselves in how we support her.

A huge thank you to Marie-Mey for her attentive listening, her kindness, and all her invaluable advice.

We contacted M&Educ for our miniature dachshund, and she listened attentively to our concerns (he wasn't walking well, barking problems at home, general anxiety, affection issues...). She taught us how to better understand and interpret his behavior. Her very practical approach and the recommended exercises were truly invaluable. Marie Mey is also available outside of sessions for any questions. My dachshund and I highly recommend her!
Marie-Mey was a great help with our little border collie, we highly recommend her! She gave us excellent advice and exercises to work on her fears, and we saw the difference very quickly 😊

Marie Mey is a fantastic trainer who helped us with our young dog's training. She's a professional who listens to both dogs and their owners, is very patient and always positive. She explained the specific needs of our breed and adapted the exercises to our dog's instincts to keep training fun and strengthen our bond. I highly recommend her; thanks to her, we have a well-adjusted dog! 🐾
Marie-Mey is exceptional! I highly recommend her!!!

Marie Mey has been with us since our little Golden Retriever arrived home. Gentle and empathetic, she's a highly competent professional and an invaluable help to us every day. She always offers excellent advice, finds practical solutions to our problems, and we can chat with her between sessions.
Nova adores her, and so do we 🐶❤️ We highly recommend her.

Fantastic dog trainer! She's very professional, attentive, and always kind, both to the dogs and their owners. Her explanations are clear and tailored to each situation, which helps you better understand your dog's behavior and the training methods to implement. Thanks to her guidance, we're starting to see real progress. It's a pleasure to work with someone so passionate and dedicated. Thank you for your support! 😊

A wonderful experience with Marie-Mey!
A great approach with my Billie.
Thank you so much.
I highly recommend her.

We met Marie Mey through the group classes she organizes with To Dog Education for our Shetland Sheepdog. We greatly appreciated the variety of activities (group walks, obedience classes, scent work, games, etc.) and the quality of the support offered: a great deal of kindness, clear explanations, and always in a relaxed, pressure-free atmosphere. Then we contacted Marie Mey for a specific issue: getting our dog used to a bicycle trailer. The home session was incredibly enriching, far exceeding our expectations. Marie Mey had already observed many things during the group sessions and gave us plenty of practical advice, always with great kindness, clear explanations, and hands-on practice. She took into account not only our dog's needs but also those of the whole family. We have a teenager with various challenges (ASD, ADHD, dyslexia, etc.), including difficulties with coordination, which makes leash handling very difficult for her. Marie Mey was looking for a way for our daughter to share an activity with her dog. During another session, she suggested a medical training program, completely adapting it after providing guidance. She is now in direct contact with our daughter, who is progressing independently at her own pace, strengthening her bond with her dog and boosting her self-confidence. In short, if you are looking for a dog trainer who is attentive, caring, non-judgmental, creative, and offers high-quality, personalized support, don't hesitate to contact her! We, for our part, will continue to benefit from her advice, which is helping both our dog and us humans progress!

A wonderful encounter with Marie, who has been and continues to be a great support for our Australian Shepherd. She listens attentively and gives us excellent training advice. I highly recommend her! 🙌 …

Invaluable help in training Chipie, adopted from the animal shelter in early January at 5 months old. Marie Mey guides us with this very muscular and stubborn little dog... The training quickly proves positive, and everything becomes much smoother with her advice. A little group work is still needed to perfect the results, but after only three personalized sessions, we can already see a very clear improvement in her responsiveness. Thank you so much, Marie Mey, we recommend you 200%! You have a real connection with our furry friends. P.S. The last photo was taken immediately after a session!

Marie Mey accompanies us and our dog Caly during group classes, group walks, and man-trailing sessions. The classes are fantastic, she's very good at explaining things, and our dog adores her. It's always a pleasure to go to the classes!

I'm a dog trainer myself (four paws and a nose). I've been working with Marie Mey for several years.

Her kind and educational approach, both with animals and humans, will help you understand your dog and improve your relationship.

Whether you have a puppy or an adult dog in the Lyon area, she's the dog trainer you need to confidently address all your challenges! 🌞

The best part? Training with a gentle and positive approach 🥰

Thank you, Marie Mey! 🙏 I highly recommend her!

I contacted M&Educ for a complete assessment of my dog ​​and I'm thrilled with the results! 🐶 She took the time to observe his behavior, understand our routines, and give me clear and personalized advice. Thanks to her gentle and professional approach, I gained practical tools to improve his daily training. Very attentive and a great teacher, I highly recommend her services to all dog owners!

Marie-Mey is excellent! I highly recommend her; thanks to her, Vanille has made tremendous progress. She teaches us all the techniques for success…
The follow-up, whether in person or via messages, is fantastic! She's very available and accommodating 🥰 There's a real sense of trust between her and Vanille! 🫶🏼✨ …
I recommend M&educ 100%! Kind, attentive, and energetic, she adapts perfectly to both the dog and the person on the other end of the leash. I honestly had a great experience with her.

I met with Marie for an assessment with my dog.

Her methods are positive, respectful of the dog, and non-judgmental towards the human.

The sessions are friendly and relaxed.

Highly recommended.

We continued our walks and group classes with Marie-Mey after our previous trainer moved out, following her advice. We're thrilled, and so is our Shiba Inu 😊 A huge thank you to her for her support! …

A wonderful experience! I spoke with Marie Mey about the needs of our dog, Laïka. She listened attentively and quickly understood how to best support us. Marie Mey is passionate about her work, and it shows! Go for it without hesitation.
Excellent dog trainer: professional, caring, and attentive. Her methods are positive and effective. She offers group classes and walks that are very enriching for my dog. I highly recommend her!

We adopted a dog from the shelter who was clearly affected by the experience, struggling to manage his emotions and hyperactive! It was a difficult first experience with a dog. Marie has been helping us for two months now, and the challenging yet fun exercises she's put in place are allowing us to make progress. Today, we can see the results!
The method suits us perfectly.
She is very professional, rigorous, and precise in her instructions, and we also enjoy some really fun moments like group walks and mantraining.
Thank you!
Excellent educator, attentive and caring, I highly recommend her!

Marie-Mey Juillet is both a pleasant and highly professional person. She knows how to put both dogs and humans at ease, with a positive approach that truly brings benefits and positive change. Her guidance is serious, caring, and always respectful of the dog-handler partnership. I highly recommend her; she can only bring positive results.
A very friendly and smiling educator, I highly recommend her! :)
Marie Mey is very attentive and competent! She will help you with professionalism and kindness ☺️

Marie Mey is a gentle and patient trainer. She always answers our questions and adapts to us and our dog.

She uses positive reinforcement training, which is exactly what we wanted for our little Happy's training.
Whether in individual lessons, group classes, or group walks, we learn and grow with our dog thanks to Marie Mey and her colleague at To Dog Éducation (classes and group walks).

A huge thank you for all the patience, kindness, and invaluable advice I received with my dog ​​Rainy! Each session is a truly special moment of sharing, filled with attentive listening, motivation, and good humor.
The approach is always tailored to the dog, respectful of them, and meaningful, making progress visible both during the sessions and at home.
It's a real pleasure to learn and grow in such a positive environment. I have complete confidence in the trainer, and I am truly grateful for everything I've been able to discover and put into practice thanks to their guidance. Thank you again for everything, and see you very soon!

Marie-Mey came to our aid during the most difficult times with our Border Collie. She was able to analyze and understand his behavior and gave us the tools we needed to calm him down and improve our daily lives. Since then, everything is better, and we've never been closer to our dog! We highly recommend her!

M&Educ: The trainer who knows how to whisper in our dogs' ears 🐶. In just 5 lessons, our Timon (2 years old) has made incredible progress thanks to this educational, flexible, and available trainer. She identified his weaknesses without overwhelming us, using varied and fun training methods. The written summaries after each session were very helpful for working at home. A true enthusiast who has it in her blood! A huge thank you to you, Marie-Mey, for your expertise and kindness. Highly recommended! 🐾
Thank you Marie-Mey for your valuable advice on supporting our dog as he ages!
